item.title: Fire Department — Procurement: Airway Management and Hemorrhage Control Training Manikins
item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
Procurement of medical training manikins and task trainers, including Airway Plus Lifecast units with pulse and breathing features (models APL-PB2 and APL-PB2-AA), a hemorrhage control classroom trainer and a tourniquet application training arm with integrated blood fill system. The tourniquet trainer includes a full arm with hand, blood fill syringe, and quick start guide, designed to support realistic hands-on emergency response and bleeding control training.
